newsitem.title: GERMANY: Euro regional airlines passengers up 13pct in H1.
newsitem.headline: Euro regional airlines passengers up 13pct in H1.

text.p: European regional airlines said they recorded a 13 percent rise in passenger numbers in the first half of 1996, which was more than double the overall European passenger market growth.

European Regional Airlines (ERA) director-general, Mike Ambrose also told the organisation's annual conference on Wednesday that the average passenger load factor was 53.1 percent, which was 0.2 percent down year-on-year.
